시편-64-1.title: 시편 64장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-1.exegesis: 11. the king-- that is, David himself, and all who reverence God, "shall share a glorious part," while treacherous foes shall be for ever silenced ( Psa 62:4 ).
시편-64-1.theologicalNote: 11. the king-- that is, David himself, and all who reverence God, "shall share a glorious part," while treacherous foes shall be for ever silenced ( Psa 62:4 ).

시편-64-2.title: 시편 64장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-2.exegesis: PSALM 64 Psa 64:1-10 . A prayer for deliverance from cunning and malicious enemies, with a confident view of their overthrow, which will honor God and give joy to the righteous. 1. preserve ... fear-- as well as the danger producing it.
시편-64-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 64 Psa 64:1-10 . A prayer for deliverance from cunning and malicious enemies, with a confident view of their overthrow, which will honor God and give joy to the righteous. 1. preserve ... fear-- as well as the danger producing it.

시편-64-3.title: 시편 64장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-3.exegesis: 2. insurrection-- literally, "uproar," noisy assaults, as well as their secret counsels.
시편-64-3.theologicalNote: 2. insurrection-- literally, "uproar," noisy assaults, as well as their secret counsels.

시편-64-4.title: 시편 64장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-4.exegesis: 3-4. Similar figures for slander ( Psa 57:4 ; 59:7 ). bend-- literally, "tread," or, "prepared." The allusion is to the mode of bending a bow by treading on it; here, and in Psa 58:7 , transferred to arrows.
시편-64-4.theologicalNote: 3-4. Similar figures for slander ( Psa 57:4 ; 59:7 ). bend-- literally, "tread," or, "prepared." The allusion is to the mode of bending a bow by treading on it; here, and in Psa 58:7 , transferred to arrows.

시편-64-5.title: 시편 64장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-5.exegesis: 3-4. Similar figures for slander ( Psa 57:4 ; 59:7 ). bend-- literally, "tread," or, "prepared." The allusion is to the mode of bending a bow by treading on it; here, and in Psa 58:7 , transferred to arrows.

시편-64-6.title: 시편 64장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-6.exegesis: 5. A sentiment here more fully presented, by depicting their deliberate malice.
시편-64-6.theologicalNote: 5. A sentiment here more fully presented, by depicting their deliberate malice.

시편-64-7.title: 시편 64장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-7.exegesis: 6. This is further evinced by their diligent efforts and deeply laid schemes.
시편-64-7.theologicalNote: 6. This is further evinced by their diligent efforts and deeply laid schemes.

시편-64-8.title: 시편 64장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-8.exegesis: 7. The contrast is heightened by representing God as using weapons like theirs.
시편-64-8.theologicalNote: 7. The contrast is heightened by representing God as using weapons like theirs.

시편-64-9.title: 시편 64장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-9.exegesis: 8. their ... tongue to fall, &c.-- that is, the consequences of their slanders, &c. (compare Psa 10:2 ; 31:16 ). all that see ... away-- Their partners in evil shall be terrified.
시편-64-9.theologicalNote: 8. their ... tongue to fall, &c.-- that is, the consequences of their slanders, &c. (compare Psa 10:2 ; 31:16 ). all that see ... away-- Their partners in evil shall be terrified.

시편-64-10.title: 시편 64장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-64-10.exegesis: 9-10. Men, generally, will acknowledge God's work, and the righteous, rejoicing in it, shall be encouraged to trust Him ( Psa 58:10 ).
시편-64-10.theologicalNote: 9-10. Men, generally, will acknowledge God's work, and the righteous, rejoicing in it, shall be encouraged to trust Him ( Psa 58:10 ).
